fields.name: id
fields.comment: URL hash used as the document key for idempotent mergeOrUpload operations.

fields.name: url
fields.comment: Original article URL retained for retrieval. Full article text is stored in ADLS.

fields.name: title
fields.comment: Article title indexed with the Microsoft English analyzer for stemming, stop-word handling, and contractions.

fields.name: body_snippet
fields.comment: First 500 characters of article content. The complete article text remains in ADLS.

fields.name: source
fields.comment: News provider name. Supports filtering and source-based facets.

fields.name: category
fields.comment: NewsAPI category such as technology, business, science, or health.

fields.name: published_at
fields.comment: Article publication timestamp used for date filtering and recency-based sorting.

fields.name: sentiment_label
fields.comment: Sentiment classification: positive, negative, neutral, or mixed.

fields.name: sentiment_score_positive
fields.comment: Positive sentiment confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0 returned by Azure Language.

fields.name: entities
fields.comment: Flattened entity names extracted from the article, such as organizations, people, and locations.

fields.name: key_phrases
fields.comment: Important phrases extracted by Azure Language and indexed for keyword-based retrieval.

fields.name: content_vector
fields.comment: 1536-dimensional text-embedding-ada-002 vector. Kept non-retrievable because vectors are not returned to API clients.

algorithms.name: hnsw-config
algorithms.comment: HNSW configuration using cosine similarity. m controls graph connectivity, while efConstruction and efSearch control build and query quality.

configurations.name: semantic-config
configurations.comment: Semantic ranking re-scores the retrieved results using title, body, key phrases, and entities as contextual signals.

functions.comment: Recent articles receive a higher relevance score, with the boost decaying logarithmically over seven days.

corsOptions.comment: CORS is restricted to the APIM gateway domain. Replace the placeholder with the deployed APIM hostname.
